content: How many spies did Joshua secretly send to look at Jericho?
explanation: They stayed at Rahab's house. “Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim” (Joshua 2:1, BSB)

content: In Jericho, whose house did Joshua's two spies stay in?
explanation: She protected them. “So they went and entered the house of a prostitute named Rahab and stayed there.” (Joshua 2:1, BSB)

content: Where did Rahab hide Joshua's spies from the king of Jericho's men?
explanation: She risked her life for them. “But Rahab had taken them up to the roof and hidden them among the stalks of flax” (Joshua 2:6, BSB)

content: What did Rahab tell Joshua's spies she believed about the LORD?
options: He is God of heaven and earth
explanation: She had heard what God did. “for the LORD your God is God in the heavens above and on the earth below.” (Joshua 2:11, BSB)

content: How did Rahab help Joshua's spies escape from Jericho?
options: Let them down by a rope
explanation: Her house was built into the wall. “Then Rahab let them down by a rope through the window” (Joshua 2:15, BSB)

content: What did Joshua's spies tell Rahab to tie in her window?
explanation: It would mark her house to be spared. “you have tied this scarlet cord in the window through which you let us down” (Joshua 2:18, BSB)

content: When Jericho fell, why did Joshua spare Rahab and her family?
explanation: She had shown kindness. “And Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her father’s household and all who belonged to her, because she hid the men” (Joshua 6:25, BSB)

content: How many days did God tell Israel to march around Jericho once a day?
explanation: The seventh day was different. “March around the city with all the men of war, circling the city one time. Do this for six days.” (Joshua 6:3, BSB)

content: At Jericho, what did seven priests carry in front of the ark?
explanation: They blew them as they marched. “Have seven priests carry seven rams’ horns in front of the ark.” (Joshua 6:4, BSB)

content: On the seventh day at Jericho, how many times did Israel march around the city?
explanation: Then the priests blew the horns. “Then on the seventh day, march around the city seven times” (Joshua 6:4, BSB)

content: While marching around Jericho, what did Joshua tell the people not to do?
explanation: They had to wait for his signal. “do not let one word come out of your mouth until the day I tell you to shout.” (Joshua 6:10, BSB)

content: After the seventh time around Jericho, what did Joshua command the people?
explanation: The LORD had given them the city. “Shout! For the LORD has given you the city!” (Joshua 6:16, BSB)

content: When the people gave a great shout at Jericho, what happened?
explanation: God gave them the victory. “When they heard the blast of the horn, the people gave a great shout, and the wall collapsed.” (Joshua 6:20, BSB)

content: Before the battle of Jericho, what did the LORD tell Joshua?
options: I have delivered Jericho to you
explanation: The victory was God's. “Behold, I have delivered Jericho into your hand” (Joshua 6:2, BSB)

content: After Moses died, whom did the LORD speak to as Israel's new leader?
explanation: He had been Moses' assistant. “the LORD spoke to Joshua son of Nun, Moses’ assistant” (Joshua 1:1, BSB)

content: When Joshua became leader, what did God command him to be?
explanation: God was with him wherever he went. “Have I not commanded you to be strong and courageous?” (Joshua 1:9, BSB)

content: How did Israel cross the Jordan River under Joshua?
explanation: The waters stood still. “while all Israel crossed over the dry ground” (Joshua 3:17, BSB)

content: After crossing the Jordan, how many stones did Israel take from the river?
explanation: One for each tribe. “Take up for yourselves twelve stones from the middle of the Jordan” (Joshua 4:3, BSB)

content: What did Joshua say he and his house would do?
explanation: He asked Israel to choose. “As for me and my house, we will serve the LORD!” (Joshua 24:15, BSB)

content: God told Joshua to meditate on the Book of the Law how often?
explanation: Then he would prosper. “meditate on it day and night” (Joshua 1:8, BSB)

content: God promised Joshua, “As I was with Moses, so will I be with…”
explanation: God would never leave him. “As I was with Moses, so will I be with you” (Joshua 1:5, BSB)

content: God promised Joshua every place his foot would tread on would be what?
explanation: God kept His promise to Moses. “I have given you every place where the sole of your foot will tread” (Joshua 1:3, BSB)

content: Who sent men to Rahab to demand she bring out the Israelite spies?
explanation: He heard spies had come. “So the king of Jericho sent to Rahab” (Joshua 2:3, BSB)

content: Where did Rahab tell the spies to hide for three days?
explanation: Their pursuers would not find them. “Go to the hill country” (Joshua 2:16, BSB)

content: Rahab told the spies Jericho had heard how the LORD dried up which sea?
explanation: Fear of Israel had spread. “For we have heard how the LORD dried up the waters of the Red Sea before you” (Joshua 2:10, BSB)

content: When Israel came to cross the Jordan, what state was the river in?
explanation: It was harvest season. “Now the Jordan overflows its banks throughout the harvest season.” (Joshua 3:15, BSB)

content: At the Jordan, the water stopped when whose feet touched it?
explanation: God went ahead of His people. “as soon as the priests carrying the ark reached the Jordan and their feet touched the water’s edge” (Joshua 3:15, BSB)

content: Why did Joshua have stones taken from the Jordan and set up?
options: To make an altar for Baal
explanation: Children would ask what they meant. “to serve as a sign among you.” (Joshua 4:6, BSB)

content: Near Jericho, who did the man with the drawn sword say He was?
explanation: Joshua fell facedown before Him. “I have now come as Commander of the LORD’s army.” (Joshua 5:14, BSB)

content: What did the Commander of the LORD's army tell Joshua to take off?
explanation: The place was holy. “Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy.” (Joshua 5:15, BSB)

content: Who took things devoted to the LORD after Jericho fell?
explanation: God's anger burned against Israel. “Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, took some of what was set apart.” (Joshua 7:1, BSB)

content: Where did Achan hide what he took from Jericho?
options: In the ground in his tent
explanation: He had coveted them. “They are hidden in the ground inside my tent, with the silver underneath.” (Joshua 7:21, BSB)

content: How did the people of Gibeon trick Joshua?
options: Pretended to come from far away
explanation: They wore old clothes and carried moldy bread. “carrying on their donkeys worn-out sacks and old wineskins, cracked and mended.” (Joshua 9:4, BSB)

content: When Joshua prayed over Gibeon, what stood still in the sky?
explanation: God fought for Israel. “So the sun stood still and the moon stopped” (Joshua 10:13, BSB)

content: In his farewell, what did Joshua ask Israel to choose this day?
explanation: He chose the LORD. “then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve” (Joshua 24:15, BSB)

content: How old was Joshua when he died?
explanation: He was the servant of the LORD. “Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110.” (Joshua 24:29, BSB)

content: How old was Caleb when he asked Joshua for the hill country?
explanation: He was still strong. “So here I am today, eighty-five years old” (Joshua 14:10, BSB)

content: From which place did Joshua send the two spies to Jericho?
explanation: Israel camped there before crossing. “Then Joshua son of Nun secretly sent two spies from Shittim” (Joshua 2:1, BSB)

content: How long did Rahab tell the spies to hide in the hill country?
explanation: Until the pursuers returned. “Hide yourselves there for three days until they have returned” (Joshua 2:16, BSB)

content: When the Jordan stopped, near which city did the water pile up upstream?
explanation: It was in the area of Zarethan. “It backed up as far upstream as Adam, a city in the area of Zarethan” (Joshua 3:16, BSB)

content: Who carried the twelve stones out of the Jordan?
explanation: Each carried a stone on his shoulder. “So Joshua summoned the twelve men he had appointed from the Israelites, one from each tribe” (Joshua 4:4, BSB)

content: After Jericho fell, where did Israel put the silver, gold, bronze, and iron?
explanation: It was set apart for God. “they put the silver and gold and articles of bronze and iron into the treasury of the LORD’s house.” (Joshua 6:24, BSB)

content: What kind of beautiful cloak did Achan take at Jericho?
explanation: He also took silver and gold. “When I saw among the spoils a beautiful cloak from Shinar” (Joshua 7:21, BSB)

content: Achan, who took devoted things from Jericho, was from which tribe?
explanation: His sin brought trouble on Israel. “of the tribe of Judah, took some of what was set apart.” (Joshua 7:1, BSB)

content: When Joshua told the sun to stand still, over which valley did the moon stop?
explanation: The sun stood over Gibeon. “O moon, over the Valley of Aijalon.” (Joshua 10:12, BSB)

content: In which book was the day the sun stood still also written?
explanation: Joshua mentions this record. “Is this not written in the Book of Jashar?” (Joshua 10:13, BSB)

content: Where was Israel's camp when the Gibeonites came asking for a treaty?
explanation: They pretended to be from far away. “They went to Joshua in the camp at Gilgal” (Joshua 9:6, BSB)

content: How many years had God kept Caleb alive since His promise to Moses?
explanation: Caleb was now eighty-five. “He has kept me alive these forty-five years since He spoke this word to Moses” (Joshua 14:10, BSB)
